hip_spread.notes: At -30 deg the leg is exactly 90 deg perpendicular to the chassis body. At +90 deg it is fully extended forward.

knee_height.notes: Full 180-deg vertical sweep! +90 deg points straight up to sky (Can-Can), -90 deg points straight down (Stilt).

fr.notes: Symmetrically transposed from fl (hardware reversed in firmware).

rear_legs.notes: Symmetrically transposed vertical knee limits (+90 up, -90 down). Hips require collision-avoidance check before swinging forward into front leg space.

kinematic_takeaways.software_zero_vs_physical_zero: Software 0 deg spread is physically 30 deg forward from perpendicular line.
